rules.title: Circuit Breaker Pattern
rules.check: All external service calls MUST use circuit breaker pattern to prevent cascade failures.
rules.rationale: Circuit breakers prevent overwhelming failing services and allow recovery time.

rules.title: Retry with Exponential Backoff
rules.check: Transient failures MUST use retry with exponential backoff and jitter.
rules.rationale: Exponential backoff with jitter prevents thundering herd and allows services to recover.

rules.title: Timeout Policies
rules.check: All external calls MUST have explicit timeouts. Never wait indefinitely.
rules.bad_example:
var response = await _httpClient.GetAsync("/api/data");
// No timeout - can hang forever
rules.rationale: Timeouts prevent resource exhaustion and provide predictable failure modes.

rules.title: Bulkhead Isolation
rules.check: Critical paths SHOULD use bulkhead isolation to prevent resource starvation.
rules.rationale: Bulkheads isolate resources so failures in one component don't exhaust shared resources.

rules.title: Idempotency Keys
rules.check: All mutating operations MUST support idempotency keys for safe retries.
rules.rationale: Idempotency keys enable safe retries without duplicate side effects.

rules.title: Correlation ID Propagation
rules.check: All requests MUST propagate correlation IDs across service boundaries.
rules.rationale: Correlation IDs enable distributed tracing and debugging across service boundaries.

rules.title: Outbox Pattern
rules.check: Event publishing with database updates MUST use the outbox pattern for reliability.
rules.rationale: Outbox pattern ensures atomic database + event publishing with guaranteed delivery.

rules.title: Distributed Locks
rules.check: Distributed operations requiring coordination MUST use distributed locks with TTL.
rules.rationale: Distributed locks prevent concurrent modifications across multiple service instances.

rules.title: Event-Driven Architecture
rules.check: Cross-service communication SHOULD prefer events over synchronous calls.
rules.rationale: Event-driven architecture provides loose coupling, better resilience, and scalability.

rules.title: Saga Pattern
rules.check: Multi-step distributed transactions SHOULD use saga pattern with compensation.
rules.rationale: Saga pattern maintains consistency across distributed transactions with automatic rollback.

rules.title: Health Checks for Dependencies
rules.check: All external dependencies MUST have health checks exposed via /health endpoints.
rules.bad_example:
app.MapHealthChecks("/health");
// Only checks if app is running, not dependencies
rules.rationale: Dependency health checks enable proper orchestration and traffic management.

rules.title: Service Discovery
rules.check: Microservices SHOULD use service discovery instead of hardcoded URLs.
rules.rationale: Service discovery enables dynamic scaling and failover without configuration changes.

rules.title: No external calls without timeout
rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No external calls without timeout

rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No retry without backoff

rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No mutating operations without idempotency support

rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No cross-service calls without correlation ID

rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No database + event publish without outbox/transactional outbox

rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No in-memory locks in distributed systems

rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No synchronous chains across more than 2 services

rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No hardcoded service URLs in production

rules.check: FORBIDDEN: No missing health checks for external dependencies
